review: skipped 701.27d: the reason claimed every non-self transform selects Humans; Waxing Moon, the Incubator transformers and The Golden-Gear Colossus also exist, reworded the reason to name them (none reaches an instant or sorcery back face)

skipped.reason: no Forge effect can transform a permanent whose other face is an instant or sorcery: the transform effects that act on another permanent select Humans (Moonmist), Werewolves (Waxing Moon), Incubator tokens (Elvish Vatkeeper and others) or double-faced artifacts (The Golden-Gear Colossus), and the only double-faced permanents with a sorcery back face, the Invasion battles, are none of these and carry no transform instruction of their own

scenarios.title: Transforming turns a double-faced permanent over; a permanent that is not double-faced is unchanged

setup.notes: Delver of Secrets is a Human Wizard 1/1 on its front face (Insectile Aberration, a 3/2 flyer, on its back).

decisions: A casts Moonmist, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Moonmist resolves, transforming all Humans.

variants.label: double_faced
variants.expected: Delver of Secrets turns over and is Insectile Aberration, a blue 3/2 Human Insect with flying. Moonmist is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_double_faced
variants.delta: A controls Elite Vanguard (a Human, not double-faced) instead of Delver of Secrets.
variants.expected: Elite Vanguard stays a 2/1 white Human Soldier; it has no other face to show. Moonmist is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Moonmist selects Humans with Defined$ Valid Creature.Human; the non-double-faced Human is simply skipped by SetState.

scenarios.title: Transforming does not trigger 'turned face up' abilities

setup.notes: Daru Lancer is a face-down 2/2 creature with no types. Aven Farseer is a 1/1 flyer with no counters.

decisions: A casts Moonmist, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Moonmist resolves and Delver of Secrets transforms.

variants.label: transform
variants.expected: Delver of Secrets is Insectile Aberration. Aven Farseer's turned-face-up trigger does not fire; Aven Farseer is a 1/1 with no counters. Daru Lancer is still face down.

variants.label: turn_face_up
variants.delta: Instead of casting Moonmist, A turns Daru Lancer face up by paying its morph cost {2}{W}{W} with all four lands.
variants.expected: Daru Lancer is face up (3/4 first strike). Aven Farseer's trigger fires and resolves: Aven Farseer has one +1/+1 counter and is 2/2. Delver of Secrets stays on its front face.

scenarios.title: A 'transforms into a non-Human creature' trigger fires only when the new face has that characteristic

setup.notes: Cult of the Waxing Moon is a Human Shaman 5/4 and is not double-faced. Villagers of Estwald is a Human Werewolf 2/3 whose back face, Howlpack of Estwald, is a 4/6 Werewolf.

decisions: A casts Moonmist, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Moonmist resolves and transforms all Humans.
Cult of the Waxing Moon's trigger, if it fired, goes on the stack and A passes priority to resolve it.

variants.label: into_non_human
variants.expected: Villagers of Estwald is Howlpack of Estwald, a 4/6 Werewolf. Cult of the Waxing Moon's trigger fires and A gets a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.

variants.label: into_human
variants.delta: A controls Delver of Secrets instead of Villagers of Estwald.
variants.expected: Delver of Secrets is Insectile Aberration, a Human Insect. Cult of the Waxing Moon's trigger does not fire and A has no Wolf token.

scenarios.title: A 'transforms into' trigger also fires when a permanent converts, if the new face has the characteristic

setup.notes: Arcee, Sharpshooter is a 2/2 artifact creature Robot; converted it is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, a Vehicle with living metal (a creature only during A's turn).

decisions: A activates Arcee's ability, paying {1} with Mountain and removing the +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and Arcee converts.
Cult of the Waxing Moon's trigger, if it fired, goes on the stack and A passes priority to resolve it.

variants.label: converts_to_creature
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, a non-Human Vehicle that is a creature on A's turn. Cult's trigger fires and A gets a 2/2 Wolf token.

variants.label: converts_to_non_creature
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B's main phase 1), and A activates Arcee's ability at instant speed after B passes priority.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, a Vehicle that is not a creature on B's turn. Cult's trigger does not fire and A has no Wolf token.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge fires its Transformed trigger for Mode$ Transform whatever the effect's wording. Arcee's living metal makes it a creature only on A's turn.

scenarios.title: A transform instruction from a triggered ability is ignored if the permanent already transformed since the ability went on the stack

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first. Delver of Secrets' upkeep trigger has just been put on the stack.

decisions: Delver of Secrets' trigger is on the stack.
A passes priority and, when the trigger resolves, looks at Lightning Bolt and reveals it.

variants.label: single_transform
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is revealed and Delver of Secrets transforms: it is Insectile Aberration, a 3/2 flyer.

variants.label: transformed_in_response
variants.delta: With the trigger on the stack, A casts Moonmist in response (tapping both Forests) and it resolves first; then the trigger resolves, A revealing Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Moonmist transforms Delver of Secrets to Insectile Aberration. The trigger resolves, Lightning Bolt is revealed, and the transform instruction is ignored: Insectile Aberration stays face up and does not turn back into Delver of Secrets.
